title: fSRD: Fuzzy Spectral Region Decomposition -- Automated Multi Operator Koopman Representations via an Adaptive Spectral Learning Architecture
abstract: arXiv:2607.17990v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Highly nonlinear chaotic dynamical systems remain difficult to model due to fundamental trade-offs between complexity, expressivity, and data efficiency. Modern machine learning methods achieve strong predictive performance but often rely on a-priori system knowledge or curated data with limited interpretability. Koopman operator theory offers a promising direction via linear representation in an infinite-dimensional observable space. However, many data-driven Koopman methods seek globally valid operators for which useful finite-dimensional spectral embeddings remain difficult to identify under these constraints. To overcome associated limitations, we introduce Fuzzy Spectral Region Decomposition (fSRD), a fully automated learning framework for estimating finite Koopman representation via multiple operators. The proposed method realizes a data-adaptive framework for assembling locally invariant embeddings, termed Invariant Decomposit

translated_title: fSRD：模糊谱区域分解——基于自适应谱学习架构的自动化多算子Koopman表示
translated_abstract: 高度非线性的混沌动力系统由于在复杂性、表达能力和数据效率之间存在根本性的权衡，仍然难以建模。现代机器学习方法虽然能实现强大的预测性能，但往往依赖于先验系统知识或精心整理的数据，且可解释性有限。Koopman算子理论通过在无限维可观测空间中进行线性表示，提供了一个有前景的研究方向。然而，许多数据驱动的Koopman方法寻求全局有效的算子，而在此类约束条件下，找到有用的有限维谱嵌入仍然十分困难。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了模糊谱区域分解，这是一个完全自动化的学习框架，用于通过多个算子估计有限的Koopman表示。所提出的方法实现了一个数据自适应框架，用于组装局部不变嵌入，称为不变分解
tldr: 提出了模糊谱区域分解，一种完全自动化的数据自适应谱学习架构，通过多个局部算子构建有限Koopman表示，克服了传统全局Koopman方法在建模高度非线性混沌系统时的局限性。
en_tdlr: We propose Fuzzy Spectral Region Decomposition (fSRD), a fully automated data-adaptive spectral learning architecture that constructs finite Koopman representations via multiple local operators, overcoming the limitations of global Koopman methods for modeling highly nonlinear chaotic dynamical systems.
